surface_functionalization: Hydrophilicization through heating in N2 flow and exposure to H2O vapor
evidence: We used RCA-cleaned B-doped p-Si(001) wafers, which were treated with diluted HF to remove the SiO2 and form an H-terminated Si surface. Hydrophilicization and high-k deposition were performed in a cluster of metal chambers equipped with ALD and rapid thermal annealing systems, at a base vacuum pressure of less than 1 /C2 10 /C0 7 Torr.
